main.description: Import the authenticated account's space repo from a STAR file, for account migration. If the account is the space's authority, the space must first be imported with importSpaceMeta. Requires auth, implemented by PDS.

errors.name: SpaceNotFound
errors.description: The account is the space's authority, and the space has not been imported yet.

errors.name: InvalidRepoFile
errors.description: The STAR file is malformed or fails verification.

errors.name: RepoMismatch
errors.description: The repo in the STAR file does not belong to the authenticated account.
